name: z7paez-computer-hygiene
goal: Prove launched sessions receive cleanup guidance, Tracker refuses completion or blocking without a hygiene attestation, and both agent profiles receive the bundled skill.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The installed brief omits the hygiene skill and proof format, and native tracker done/block accept missing proof inside a launched session.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthen the existing per-computer brief and native command compatibility cases. Exercise the Tracker CLI and its actual mutation handler with a disposable database, then check the signed-loopback scenario on MB2.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Harness recorded 47069b1ad5fb185d892320c4cc38695694de494b: two focused cases failed. The brief omitted the skill rule and the CLI returned 0 for a forced block with no hygiene line.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Scope the CLI gate to the launched session’s own item using the existing launch environment. Add the matching skill and completion rule to the shared brief. Reuse PR #444 for the installed bundle.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged red/green checkpoints 03574b6bb1 and b45309214a, followed by the compact-format red 0d541672c1 and green 36ce57313b. Both pairs were sealed through Harness. The focused brief, CLI, structured ask, and canary tests passed 30/30.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
